Maya (CSM): Quick ping  WillowHealth wants to move the upcoming 12m renewal to a 9m amendment and reduce seats 20 -> 15. Procurement says new PO + signed amendment required before eSign. Who owns which steps?
Evan (WillowHealth): Confirmed. CFO approved shorter term. We'll keep same per-seat rate. PO will reference original contract 7492-RED.
Tom (Finance): net30 ok. PO must include billing entity name, vendor_code (8491-US for US), and tax ID. PDF preferred.
Maya (CSM): Sample PO payload to paste: {"po_number":"<PO#>", "billing_entity":"WillowHealth, Inc.", "vendor_code":"8491-US", "term_months":"9", "tax_id":"12-3456789"} Attach PDF when ready.
Nina (Legal): I'll draft Amendment v2 (term + seat reduction + proration). Need counterparty legal contact to expedite. If Willow can return redlines within 48h we should hit the billing cutoff.
Evan (WillowHealth): Adding Jess Carter (jess.carter@willowhealth.com) to the thread. We'll aim to send PO by tomorrow EOD.
Diego (Onboarding): Heads-up: I'll remove 5 seats from training roster and rebook remaining 15. Recommend enablement week-of-21. I'll set entitlement update to the 1st of next month after PO clears to avoid mid-cohort issues.
docusign-bot: Placeholder envelope will be created when PO PDF + signed amendment are attached.
Maya (CSM): Action items: 1) Evan to upload PO PDF with vendor_code and tax id by EOD tomorrow; 2) Nina to post amendment draft to thread; 3) Tom confirmed net30; 4) Diego to block enablement week-of-21 and plan entitlement change on the 1st; 5) I will create DocuSign envelope once docs attached and post envelope id here.
Evan (WillowHealth): Thanks all  will send PO tomorrow and loop Jess. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
